#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <set>

int main() {
    int n, m;
    std::cin >> n >> m;
    std::vector<int> a(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        std::cin >> a[i];
    }

    int half = n / 2;
    std::vector<int> part1, part2;
    part1.reserve(1 << half);
    part2.reserve(1 << (n - half));

    // Generate all subset sums for the first half
    std::function<void(int, int)> create_sums1 = [&](int i, int total) {
        if (i == half) {
            part1.push_back(total % m);
        } else {
            create_sums1(i + 1, total + a[i]);
            create_sums1(i + 1, total);
        }
    };

    // Generate all subset sums for the second half
    std::function<void(int, int)> create_sums2 = [&](int i, int total) {
        if (i == n) {
            part2.push_back(total % m);
        } else {
            create_sums2(i + 1, total + a[i]);
            create_sums2(i + 1, total);
        }
    };

    create_sums1(0, 0);
    create_sums2(half, 0);

    int best_sum = 0;
    std::set<int> part1_set(part1.begin(), part1.end());
    std::vector<int> resulting_list;
    for (int i : part2) {
        auto it = part1_set.lower_bound(m - i);
        if (it != part1_set.begin()) {
            --it;
            int candidate = *it + i;
            if (candidate > best_sum) {
                best_sum = candidate;
            }
        }
        resulting_list.push_back(best_sum);
    }
    std::cout << resulting_list.back() << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
